data.name: Synthaly Universe
data.detailed_description:
Step into Synthaly Universe, a vast and mysterious world built for exploration, discovery, and curiosity. Every corner of the world holds something hidden, from ancient ruins and forgotten structures to secrets waiting quietly beneath the surface.

This is not a world that reveals itself easily. It rewards those who take their time, who observe, and who question what they see. Paths are not always obvious, and the deeper you explore, the more the world begins to unfold.

Uncover layers of rich, interconnected lore scattered across the environment. Piece together stories left behind, discover the meaning behind strange locations, and begin to understand a universe that feels alive, yet strangely distant.

Every area is crafted to feel unique, with shifting atmospheres, distinct environments, and hidden details that encourage exploration at your own pace. Whether you are venturing into the unknown or simply taking in the world around you, there is always something waiting to be found.

Key Features:
• Expansive world designed for free exploration
• Deep, hidden lore woven into the environment
• Secrets, puzzles, and discoveries in every region
• Immersive atmosphere focused on curiosity and discovery
• A world that evolves as you uncover its mysteries

Encounter any issues? Your feedback helps shape the experience, and every idea, suggestion, and discovery matters.

Synthaly Universe is built for those who want more than just a destination. It is about the journey, the questions, and the moments in between.

Explore deeper. Look closer. Nothing is placed without a reason.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Settings target 1080p Low at 30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 80000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Settings target 1080p/1440p High at 60 FPS.
